# The SAME two tenants as tenant-metrics.txt, as v0.3.13 serializes them. It is RECONSTRUCTED from
# that tag's own exposition code — the order of the families, the six per-tenant lines and the three
# global gauges are what MasterAdminService renders — not from a run: the capability experiment was
# against 0.3.12.post1 and this build was never measured.
#
# What it exists to pin is the SHAPE, not the figures: four series 0.3.12.post1 emits are gone here,
# and charged_bytes and admission_closed are new. team-a's charged_bytes is non-zero so a test can
# tell "read the newer occupancy" apart from "read nothing".
